summary: Dispute over stamp duty payment for share capital increase; whether Form No.5 constitutes taxable 'instrument' under Stamp Act; Articles of Association considered primary taxable instrument with Rs.25 lakh cap; High Court ruling that Form No.5 not taxable upheld; fiscal statute interpretation strictly against revenue department; departmental recharacterization rejected under Section 14A; refund of Rs.25 lakh granted.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding refund of Rs.25 lakhs with 6% interest confirmed; stamp duty payment on Form No.5 declared invalid.
